market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Bond market stress at 20-year yield highs and oil above $103 create headwinds for equities. Trump-Xi truce extension provides a floor but lack of detail limits upside. Gold dip-buying opportunity. Yen strengthening to 150 could trigger USD/EM rotation. FTSE 100 rebound offers relative value. Expect 2-3% equity volatility over next 2-3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI monetization (Meta fees, Palantir sovereignty) supports tech leadership. India's $463B overseas opening is a multi-year capital flow tailwind for developed markets. Energy M&A cycle (BP/Devon) signals structural consolidation. Rising rates will compress non-essential valuations. Defense spending cycle (LMT, DRS) provides steady growth. Gold remains a strategic hedge.
